name: Linguistics
notes: Ten courses: five core courses plus five electives, at least three of the electives at the 200 level or above.

NEEDS VERIFICATION - tracks: the page says four of the five electives must fit either a pre-approved track (Linguistic Theory, Language Documentation and Description, Language Variation and Change, and two others) OR a specialized track arranged with the undergraduate advisor. Because individualized tracks are explicitly allowed, the track structure is NOT modeled as a hard requirement here - only the 200-level minimum is enforced. Plan your track with the Director of Undergraduate Studies.
LING 214 Statistical Methods in Linguistics is recommended, not required.

requirementGroups.label: Core courses
requirementGroups.sourceQuote: All majors must take our five core courses: LING 110 Intro to Linguistic Analysis; LING 210(W) Intro to Language Sound Systems; LING 220 Intro to Syntax; LING 225 Intro to Semantic Analysis; LING 389 Senior Seminar
